title: docs(agents): the skip-changeset label is never applied to a PR that edits an existing changeset
body:
Fixes #18375 — the remaining `.claude/**` half of ruling batch #158 item 1 (① D). The workflow-text half landed as #19013.

Clause-②: no

## Scope

Two files, one line each, net zero lines in both. No mechanics: this PR touches no
workflow, no gate script, and no `.changeset/` file.

- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` — the dev writes the label, so the prohibition and the
  advisory red belong where the act is.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` — the seat is the actor the defect was actually
  measured on. The one recorded instance applied the label from the PM side, not from a
  dev: batch #156 item 1 confirmed PR #18765's correction in writing **and** applied
  `skip-changeset` on the maintainer's authority. The seat is also the reviewer of the
  `skip-changeset` 分流 (the line this one sits under) and the author of the written
  confirmation. So one file does not carry this coherently; two do, and each carries the
  half its reader acts on rather than a symmetrical copy.

## Matching the landed text

The wording tracks #19013's route 0, which is the point of the card — a paraphrase that
shifts the rule is the defect. Landed workflow text (`.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml`,
the `Require a changeset` step):

> -> do NOT apply 'skip-changeset'. Write the confirmation on the PR --
>    name the note and what changed under it, and get it confirmed there
>    in writing -- and LEAVE THIS CHECK RED.
>
> The red is the point, and it costs nothing: 'Check Changeset' is not one
> of the required contexts, so its red blocks no merge and the approver
> merges over it. Staying red is what puts the decision in front of a
> person instead of routing around it.
> [...] the 'skip-changeset' label is never applied to a PR that
> edits an existing changeset.

This PR:

```text
os-dev.md   - PR 改到已有的 `.changeset/*.md`:⛔ 永不打 `skip-changeset`,门禁红着是对的,确认走 PR 文字。
SKILL.md    - 改到已有 `.changeset/*.md` 的 PR ⛔ 不打 `skip-changeset`;确认取维护者原话或出处三件转述。
```

Clause by clause: *edits an existing changeset* → 改到已有的 `.changeset/*.md` (the path
the step's own discriminator command reads); *do NOT apply* → ⛔ 永不打 / ⛔ 不打; *leave
this check red / the red is the point* → 门禁红着是对的; *written confirmation on the PR,
the maintainer's own word or a seat carrying it* → 确认走 PR 文字 / 确认取维护者原话或出处三件转述,
which is ruling ② B's own wording. The issue number is deliberately absent from both lines:
`check:pm-skill-id-lint` forbids issue-ID citations in this corpus, and it is green.

One adjacent line changed meaning and is corrected rather than left false:
`skip-changeset` 唯一判据是没动 loses 唯一. The ruling gives that criterion an overriding
class, so the word was falsified by this change. Nothing pins the word (`git grep` over the
repo: 1 hit, this file).

## The line budget, and a correction to the dispatch's premise

⚠️ **The dispatch and the claim comment both record `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` as carrying
no ratchet row and therefore unconstrained. Re-measured in this act, that is false**:
`check-skill-line-ratchet` covers it at **403 lines, ceiling 403, headroom 0**. The SKILL.md
numbers have also moved since the claim was written — **819/819**, not 813/813; the table-row
pin is unchanged at 342/342. So both files were at zero headroom, and both lines are paid
for with a deletion in the same file. No ceiling was raised and no re-wrap was used as
currency.

| file | deletion spent | why it is genuinely redundant |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` | `- 退出码先重定向再捕获,⛔ 永不隔着管道下结论(见本地验证范围节)。` | A pure pointer. Every clause of it is stated in full, in the same file, in the section it names by name — 门禁结果的读法:退出码在任何管道之前捕获 plus 免疫写法只有一种,先重定向再捕获 and the four trap lines under them (`$?` after a pipe, `pipefail`/`PIPESTATUS`, `head -N` and SIGPIPE, and the generalization beyond gates). Deleting the pointer removes no rule. `git grep`: 1 hit, this file. |
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` | `- 删除与二进制:死代码删除亲核引用面;\`+0/-0\` 先疑 NUL;sweep 范围外产出成组列出。` | A three-item index with no principle of its own. Each item is expanded, with strictly more detail, in `references/review-checklist.md` — dead-code deletion reference face, `+0/-0` and NUL with the blob-level verdict, and grouping sweep output — and the line two above it in the same block makes that file mandatory for every report (逐项判据展开在 `references/review-checklist.md`,每份报告对着它过). It is not in `references/core-rules.md`, so the subset invariant is untouched. `git grep`: 1 hit, this file. |

Ratchet exit code before the edit: **0** (SKILL.md 819/819 headroom 0, os-dev.md 403/403
headroom 0). After, at head `c9058f40`: **0**, both files still exactly at ceiling, both
table-row pins unchanged.

## Verification

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at
`c9058f40` derived **23** families for these two paths. All 23 were run, each exit code
captured with `cmd > log 2>&1; ec=$?` before any pipe: **23/23 exit 0**. Reconciled with
`--ran`: *23 derived, 23 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN — a DERIVED zero*.

Named among them: `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`,
`check:pm-governed-prose`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:agent-model-declared`,
`check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:nul-bytes` (9179 files, 0 control bytes),
`check:commit-card-trailers`.

Two readings worth stating rather than implying:

- A first derivation ran against a tree three commits behind `origin/main` and the tool
  said so; `origin/main` was merged in and the derivation re-run. The family list is
  byte-identical (23, no new family) and the stale-tree warning is gone. Neither of the two
  target files is touched by anything that landed in that range, so there is no collision.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited **3**,
  which is PREREQUISITE NOT MET and not a finding — it needs `@objectstack/formula` and
  `@objectstack/lint` built. Built under the shared verify lock (`VERDICT command-exit 0`)
  and re-run: exit 0. The five other non-zero results in the first pass were all
  `node_modules missing`, cleared by `pnpm install` and green on re-run.

No build or test of a product package is owed: the diff touches no package source and the
`turbo` closure is empty. (That set comes from the package dependency graph and is blind to
tests that read another package's files off disk, so it is stated as "not on the graph",
never as "cannot be affected".) No ablation: this is prose, so there is no guard whose
failure could be demonstrated.

## Changeset, and the label

**None owed, measured rather than recalled.** No package manifest lists `.claude` in its
`files[]` (positive control: the `files[]` arrays of three packages read back non-empty), so
this diff publishes nothing. `.claude/**` is on the repo's own not-published fast track.

This PR is **not** the route-0 class it describes, by the step's own discriminator:
`git diff --name-status MERGE_BASE HEAD -- '.changeset/*.md'` returns **zero rows**
(positive control: the same command without the pathspec returns exactly the two files
above, so the instrument discriminates).

⚠️ **No label was written, and that is a dispatch instruction rather than a judgement.**
This is a Tier S governed surface and the dispatch forbids adding or stripping any label, so
`skip-changeset` was not applied even though route 2 would be correct for this PR. The
consequence is recorded rather than hidden: `Check Changeset` will be **red** on this PR with
the ordinary "this PR adds no changeset" message. It is advisory — `Check Changeset` is not
one of the seven registered required contexts — and the label is one write away for whoever
takes this to ACCEPT.

## Acceptance notes

- **Landing path for the class this rule describes needs no new text, measured.**
  `pr-automation.yml` declares `on: pull_request` only, with no `merge_group` trigger, so
  `Check Changeset` never runs in the merge queue. Together with the three-condition
  red-by-design carve-out already in SKILL.md (源码自述 pushed 分支上按设计而红、不跑
  `merge_group`、PR 评论记明门与因), a correcting PR's advisory red is already covered by
  existing text. No enqueue mechanics were invented here, deliberately.
- `references/review-checklist.md` §范围与 changeset is where a seat walks the
  `skip-changeset` 分流 item by item, and it does not carry the override. It is outside this
  card's declared file surface, so it was not touched. Coverage is adequate as it stands —
  that file's own first line routes the reader to SKILL.md 〈复核〉, which is where this
  PR's line lives — so this is recorded, not filed. Carrier: the next author who edits that
  section; if the seat would rather have the override at the checklist level too, it is a
  one-line follow-up on a file this PR leaves clean.
- The L3 step-order finding stays recorded on #18375 and is **not** fixed here; ruling ① D
  rules mechanics out, and the maintainer's standing word is no more gate development.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** — 把你在 9 月 18 日那条裁决(batch #158 item 1)剩下的一半落到 agent 的规则文本里。
规则一句话:**一个 PR 如果改的是别人已经写好、还没发布的 changeset 说明,就不许打 `skip-changeset`
标签**;确认要以 PR 上的文字做(你本人的原话,或席位带出处三件转述),门禁红着是对的,红不挡合并。
两个文件各加一行:dev 的规则文件、PM 的 skill 文件。

**为什么改** — 裁决的另一半(改 workflow 里那段提示文字)已经在 #19013 合了。当时那一半只教育
*打开 CI 日志的人*;agent 的规则文本没同步,所以 agent 仍然按老规则「没动发布面就打标签」行事 ——
而这一类 PR 恰好「自己什么都不发布」,长得就像该打标签。这就是这张卡本身在说的坑。顺带更正了
一处已经变假的老措辞(原文写 `skip-changeset` 的「唯一判据」,现在有了一个压倒它的例外)。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** — 风险很低:纯文字,不碰任何 workflow、门禁脚本或发布机制,行为不变,
只有 agent 读到的规则变了。代价是两个文件都已经顶到行数上限,所以每加一行都用**删一行**来付账 ——
删的两行分别是「指向同一文件另一节的纯指路句」和「三项都在 `references/review-checklist.md` 里
展开得更细的索引句」,都不丢规则。⚠️ 有一处要你知道:派发令说 `os-dev.md` 没有行数上限,**实测是有的**
(403/403,余量 0),所以这一半也照付了账。回滚成本 = 一次 revert,无任何连带。

**席位意见** — (留空,由席位定稿)

**你要做的** — 读上面那条规则句,确认它就是你 9 月 18 日拍的板;然后决定是否合并。这是 Tier S 受管面,
PR 停在 draft,⛔ 没翻 ready、没入队、没挂 auto-merge、没动任何标签。⚠️ `Check Changeset` 会红 —
那是因为按派发令本轮零标签写入,不是缺陷。
